concerns: Falsifiable hypothesis is cut off mid-sentence; the bootstrap lower-bound threshold, sample-size floor, and alpha are unspecified, making the success criterion non-falsifiable as written

votes.reason: The core idea is sound and safe: measuring validated-state-gate conservatism via counterfactual replay through existing paper-path economics is read-only research that generates exactly the PF/EV evidence currently missing, touches no governed artifact, and makes zero MT5 mutations. However, the proposal text is truncated mid-hypothesis ('95% bootstrap lower bound at o...'), leaving the acceptance threshold undefined, and it omits several mandatory governance steps from AGENTS.md (ExperimentRegistry registration, artifact-path isolation inside bot/intel/, which contains governed runtime files). Those gaps are fixable but material.
requested_revisions: Restore the full truncated hypothesis with explicit numeric criterion: e.g. 95% bootstrap lower bound of mean counterfactual net EV per trade > $X across >= N rejected signals over 4 weeks, alpha and seed fixed in advance

Name the exact new artifact paths (e.g. bot/intel/research/rejected_signal_counterfactuals.jsonl) and affirmatively state that intelligent_champion.json, analogue_index.json, outcome_log.jsonl, and all PROTECTED_LIVE_YAML entries remain unwritten
Add explicit ExperimentRegistry registration step before the first collected signal
State that the counterfactual simulator imports the runner's existing cost/economics module rather than reimplementing spread/slippage, so costs cannot silently diverge
Report results both unconstrained and under a simple portfolio-conacity constraint (max concurrent positions / one-signal-at-a-time) to bound selection bias
Declare the deliverable as analysis-only: no automatic gate-parameter relaxation follows from positive results; any gate change enters its own promotion cycle through promote.py gates
